short_en: On December 29, 2023, the Company completed the sale of its Aluminum Products business, which has been classified as a discontinued operation for all periods presented.
full_en: On December 29, 2023, the Company completed the sale of its Aluminum Products business, which has been classified as a discontinued operation for all periods presented. On January 26, 2026, the Company's Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.125 per common share The dividend was paid on February 20, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on February 6, 2026 and resulted in cash payments of $1.8 million.
